description.value: Barrels before the Storm: Objective: establish emergency reserves. Audit the bids or negotiate delayed delivery; delay strands the camp.
The Sealed Harvest: Objective: find a safe way into the vault. Prove clean health or replace the gate filter; delay begins a purge.
Homes off the Roll: Objective: identify uncounted demand. Map Far Hearth or recover the hidden ledger; delay brings forced evacuation.
A Span for Everyone: Objective: cross without losing travelers. Reinforce the beam or stage the foot route; delay draws the dust front.
The Living Sample: Objective: separate seed from contamination. Fit a culture divider or test outdoor shoots; delay burns the room.
Heat in the Warehouse: Objective: stop unauthorized diversion. Close the bypass or secure a public inspection; delay drains repair cells.
Auction Mile: Objective: reopen public passage. Expose stolen lumber or negotiate restitution; delay seizes the truck.
An Inherited Garden: Objective: establish planting rights. Recover the joint charter or convene the seed heirs; delay erases the archive.
The Dead Factory: Objective: change grid priorities. Use the manual key or prove obsolete demand; delay shuts Far Hearth's line.
A Camp on Wheels: Objective: evacuate vulnerable travelers. Share truck space or recruit a second carrier; delay closes the foot crossing.
The Purger's Order: Objective: prevent unnecessary burning. Certify a sample or isolate the machine; delay destroys the viable strain.
Across the Cold Ridge: Objective: repair the return cable. Escort cells or open the service tunnel; delay exhausts the shelter.
The Reserve Hearing: Objective: settle the convoy's claim. Present bids and needs or witness deferred delivery; delay sells the remaining barrels.
Harvest beyond Glass: Objective: set a safe planting policy. Establish monitored beds or distribute heir boxes; delay causes a food riot.
The One-use Override: Objective: restart fair heat. Schedule shared cycles or form a joint repair team; delay freezes the control valves.
A Road Kept Open: Objective: choose passage governance. Create a road mutual or a bounded toll charter; record who funds repairs.
The Next Season: Objective: divide food and seed fairly. Fund immediate rations or protect a witnessed reserve; record who can plant.
Both Hearths Warm: Objective: settle the heat covenant. Share shortages or guarantee a minimum ration; record who represents omitted homes.
Departure Alarm: the dust front advances before the last water barrels are counted.
Closed Greenhouse: a healthy traveler is denied entry while the seed room asks for labor.
Cold Roll Call: Far Hearth names do not appear in the assembly's demand list.
Camp Signal: a broken radio asks the convoy for space beside the causeway.
Bloom Warning: the purger declares every outdoor sample contaminated.
Warehouse Steam: an unauthorized outlet glows while homes freeze.
Reserve Bid: a buyer offers repair parts in exchange for exclusive barrels.
Healthy Shoot: an outdoor bed produces evidence the vault cannot easily dismiss.
Meter Seizure: a sheriff takes the only diagnostic cell from an unregistered home.
Bridge Crack: the heavy truck's crossing threatens stranded travelers.
Charter Discovery: the archive reveals the vault was intended to serve surrounding communities.
Old Priority: the grid sends another heat cycle to an empty factory.
Broker Barricade: Auction Mile charges passage after community labor repairs the road.
Filter Failure: opening the gate now risks the viable crop unless a divider is fitted.
Return Petition: residents ask to share heat instead of accepting forced evacuation.
Mask Shortage: the foot crossing must be staged in smaller groups.
Heir Meeting: the seed heirs demand a voice in any changed planting agreement.
Repair Offer: the assembly offers cells only if the omitted houses stay off the roll.
Buyer Arrival: Tess reaches the depot before the reserve hearing.
Purger Countdown: the culture warden schedules a burn before independent testing.
Cable Fault: the last return line fails when the main boiler warms up.
Camp Council: travelers decide who needs the first transport places.
Open Soil Hearing: a clean sample can overturn the protocol under public witness.
Ration Confession: a worker admits the warehouse line was fitted during a prior freeze.
Quiet Crossing: a silent truck route becomes available at the price of leaving a load.
First Harvest: the crew chooses between immediate meals and next season's reserve.
Shared Override: the dispatcher offers one manual cycle if both settlements sign.
Road Reopened: the convoy's reserve decision changes who can use the causeway.
Seeds Released: the final charter defines who may plant and who must report failures.
Heat after Frost: the schedule reflects the crew's decision about omitted households.
